text:
lina: Quick design review — thinking about a compact preflight summary card at the end of the private setup. Main asks: 1) can we collapse per-probe details by default? 2) wording for 'All checks passed' vs 'Reachable'? 3) subtle aria-live for progress updates. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

matt: I like collapsing by default. Surface a single status pill (green/yellow/red) and a small chevron to expand. Keeps the page tidy during long runs.

devon: +1 on pill. Collapsing avoids scrolling. Implementation note: when users expand, focus should move into the list and pressing Esc should collapse and return focus to the chevron.

samira: If collapsed, the expand button needs aria-expanded and aria-controls. For live updates use a polite live region: "Network probe update: 2 of 4 checks complete" and final announce: "Network probe complete: 3 passed, 1 failed."

matt: Copy ideas — success: "Connection checks completed — all systems reachable." Partial: "Connection checks completed — 3 checks passed, 1 failed. Expand to see remediation steps." For running state: "Running checks — 2/4 complete." Keep link text short: "Open docs" not "View troubleshooting docs".

devon: Probes run in parallel so we should show incremental counts and a small spinner inline in the pill while running. Backend note: emit test-summary events that UI can consume to avoid polling.

lina: UX nit — only show primary CTA for actionable states (e.g., 'Retry failed checks' or 'Contact support'). Passive links like 'Open docs' should be subtle. Also prefer 'Retry failed checks' over 'Retry' for clarity.

ci-bot: deploy-preview created for PR #4227 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/panel/pull/4227

matt: I'll push a compact mock with the expand motion and final microcopy today. Samira — can you run keyboard & screen reader pass after I upload? :thumbsup:

samira: Yep. Also check color contrast on the small pill icons and the expanded list headers.

lina: Action items: Matt mock (EOD), Devon to add aria hooks + incremental counts, Samira to review. I'll book a 15-min sync tomorrow to sign off. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
